headline: California would put AI violation under Medical Board jurisdiction
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

California would put a physician's violation of the artificial intelligence provisions under the jurisdiction of the Medical Board of California or the Osteopathic Medical Board of California. Sent to the governor. It cites the fear that an algorithm decides whether you get treated.

379 measures in 48 jurisdictions would ban or restrict a use of AI, or make one a crime.

64 measures in 29 jurisdictions cite the fear that an algorithm decides whether you get treated.

2,212 measures tracked. 748 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 101 offices.
